conclusions.topic: Final SPK Gauss out of spec (both Test and Normal)
conclusions.statement_from_report: Result check Gauss of final SPK of test MG-S-A,-S-B,-C is same as normal MG, but NG because out of spec.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Both groups fail Final SPK Gauss spec equally (Grill MIN 5-20 vs spec 0-50 OK in floor, but MAX 219-262 vs spec 250-400 - both groups MIN AVG only 8-12 G, and MAX often below 250); the failure is not supplier-specific. Test ≈ Normal (Grill MAX 249.4 vs 222.7; Yoke MAX 517.5 vs 485.8).
